preparation_scope.NC: Entire reported stock formulations and addition direction retained; acetate mix is put into sulfide solution. Solution volumes do not assert neat-solvent charges. Inhibitor remains in acrylic acid.
preparation_scope.SMP: Feed ZnS is uncharacterized; Mn-acetate hydration and stock solvent remain unspecified. The final 125 nm radius is not transferred to its feed.
preparation_scope.coating: PAA is described as formed from acrylic acid during drying; thickness, conversion, coverage and polymer mass fraction are not given.
preparation_scope.missing_aliquot_lineage: Physical batch or exact characterization aliquot identifiers are absent.

model_context.fraction_scope: Author estimate, not measured surface fraction
model_context.general_T1_relation: T1 ∝ 1/T^n; no measured n or numeric T1 reported
model_context.coordination_I: Mn2+ with four S2− neighbors in cubic ZnS; tetrahedral site lacks inversion
model_context.coordination_II: Author-assigned near-surface Mn2+ with oxygen/carboxyl coordination; no measured atom positions
model_context.prior_XPS_scope: Referenced earlier work [11], not a current-main XPS figure or newly checked source

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1, 3–6, Introduction and EPR/PL interpretation

source_interpretation.topic: Two preparation routes, two material outcomes
source_interpretation.text: The PAA-coated NC sample is precipitated from acetate stocks and sulfide, then dried with acrylic acid. SMP is made by treating existing ZnS particles with manganese acetate and ammonia, followed by nitrogen firing. The two EPR signals are coordination environments within a sample, not additional syntheses.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Preparation, Table 2 and EPR assignment

source_interpretation.topic: Quantum confinement and the imperfect-coating possibility
source_interpretation.text: The authors relate the higher-energy NC excitation band to quantum confinement. Its reported 3.78 eV peak differs from a 4.2 eV effective-mass prediction based on measured size; they discuss coagulation and imperfect PAA coating as possible explanations. The 4.2 eV prediction and cited approximately 2.5 nm exciton Bohr radius are model/reference context, not new measurements.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 2 and size discussion

source_interpretation.text: Signal I is assigned to substitutional Mn2+ coordinated by four sulfide ions in cubic ZnS. Larger zero-field splitting and lattice distortion in NC are interpreted as lower crystal-field symmetry. Signal II, detected only for NC at Q-band, is assigned to near-surface Mn2+; its larger hyperfine splitting is linked to more ionic coordination.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 3–5, Tables 1–2 and Figures 3–6

source_interpretation.text: The source compares sulfate-related IR bands in uncoated ZnS:Mn with the PAA-coated NC spectrum and proposes carboxyl oxygen coordination near Mn sites. Cited prior XPS evidence is not newly measured in this main. This is a source-attributed coordination interpretation, not an atom-resolved shell structure.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 4–5, Figure 6 and oxygen-coordination discussion

source_interpretation.topic: Temperature-independent EPR linewidth and energy transfer
source_interpretation.text: NC signals I and II show little linewidth change while SMP signal I narrows on cooling. With the assumption of a temperature-independent spin–spin term, the authors infer stronger spin–lattice interactions and more effective ZnS–Mn and PAA–Mn energy transfer. No numerical T1 lifetime or fitted temperature exponent is reported.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 5–6, Figure 7 and relaxation discussion

source_interpretation.topic: Relative luminescence is not absolute quantum yield
source_interpretation.text: The source reports sevenfold greater NC luminescence under the same stated 350 nm excitation despite lower measured Mn content. It favors greater luminescence efficiency over reduced scattering because these small particles coagulate and acrylic acid accelerates coagulation. No absolute quantum yield or controlled scattering correction is supplied.

claims.label: Literal source wording
claims.statement: The experimental paragraph prints an orientation of 90°C relative to excitation and detection paths.

source_conflicts.handling: Retain this as an unresolved unit transcription in a geometry sentence. Do not turn it into a 90 °C measurement temperature; PL/PLE are explicitly measured at room temperature.
